args.title: checkout-api health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release healthy in production and rolled it out to all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the failures and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 root cause.
